definitions.explanation: Protection against gunfire. Used almost entirely as the first element of a compound, describing equipment or materials built to stop bullets.

examples.japanese: {防弾|ぼうだん}⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れた→割れる：00907_wareru⟧。
⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防弾|ぼうだん}チョッキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ていた→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: The police officer was wearing a bulletproof vest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防弾|ぼうだん}⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Bulletproof-grade glass is used in the president's car.

notes:
Rarely stands alone; it normally attaches to the noun it protects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防弾|ぼうだん}⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧: bulletproof glass
- {防弾|ぼうだん}チョッキ: bulletproof vest
- {防弾|ぼうだん}⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧: bulletproof specification
- {防弾|ぼうだん}{車|しゃ}: armoured car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧: waterproof — same ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧〜 "guards against ~" pattern
- ⟦{防火|ぼうか}→防火：21169_bouka⟧: fireproof, fire-preventing — likewise
- {耐火|たいか}: fire-resistant — {耐|たい}〜 stresses withstanding rather than blocking
